name: zclass_typelist_get_bucket_head
description: zClass_TypeList::GetBucketHead returns the current head link for the selected type-list bucket.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this accessor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44ed50 validates indexing the bucket-head slot table by bucket id, loading the pointed-to head link, and returning it.
The native smoke verifies the bucket head is used to seed filtered iteration over inserted list links.
